title: SB400 (2025 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2025/bills/SB400_.HTM; sha256 6718bce66d239ccbb6147422a411768970295bbbbd9570f84d5d9bd03be92bb1)
provenance.note: As-filed. HRS 134-4(c) is rewritten (12-hour loan to an adult 21 or older who holds a permit or owns a registered firearm and is not prohibited; strikes the 15-day and 75-day loan authority); its sentence runs across struck words so is not quoted. The quoted subsection (d) closing quote mark was removed.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): (d) No person shall intentionally, knowingly, or recklessly lend a firearm to any person who does not have a permit pursuant to section 134-2, does not own or possess a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, or is prohibited from ownership, possession, or control of a firearm under section 134-7.
